title: God Is My Strength and Portion Forever

questions.question: Truly God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:1 (ESV): "Truly God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart."

questions.question: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled, my steps had nearly what?
For I was envious of the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:3 (ESV): "For I was envious of the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked."

questions.question: They have no pangs until death; their bodies are what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:4 (ESV): "For they have no pangs until death; their bodies are fat and sleek."

questions.question: They are not in trouble as others are; they are not stricken like the rest of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:5 (ESV): "...they are not stricken like the rest of mankind."

questions.question: Therefore pride is their necklace; violence covers them as a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:6 (ESV): "...violence covers them as a garment."

questions.question: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongue struts through the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:9 (ESV): "...and their tongue struts through the earth."

questions.question: Behold, these are the wicked; always at ease, they increase in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:12 (ESV): "...always at ease, they increase in riches."

questions.question: But when I thought how to understand this, it seemed to me a wearisome task, until I went into the sanctuary of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:16-17 (ESV): "...until I went into the sanctuary of God; then I discerned their end."

questions.question: Truly you set them in slippery places; you make them fall to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:18 (ESV): "...you make them fall to ruin."

questions.question: When my soul was embittered, when I was pricked in heart, I was brutish and ignorant; I was like a what toward you?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:21-22 (ESV): "...I was like a beast toward you."

questions.question: Nevertheless, I am continually with you; you hold my right what?
You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will receive me to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:24 (ESV): "...and afterward you will receive me to glory."

questions.question: Whom have I in heaven but you? And there is nothing on earth that I desire besides whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:25 (ESV): "...And there is nothing on earth that I desire besides you."

questions.question: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 73:26 (ESV): "...but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever."

key_verse_text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
